1879064144.Skill_Desc:
An AoE double-strike inflicting moderate damage.

Requires Battle-readied State.

Using this skill enables the Battle-hardened state, boosting healing and defences.

Critical hits trigger a Defeat Response.

1879104848.Skill_Desc: A plague of flies fills a foetid gourd which explodes on your opponent.\n On critical hit, reduces your opponents Block, Parry, and Evade for 20s.

1879110224.Skill_Desc: Requires Dissonance or Melody Stance.\n\nDeals Light damage to a single target, with a high Critical chance.

1879138640.Skill_Desc: A gourd filled with flies is launched at your opponent. After the gourd is cracked open, the flies will swarm out obscuring vision and draining power from nearby targets, restoring Power to the Defiler.\n\nFlies are only able to blind Players.

1879160016.Skill_Desc: The Galadhrim have chosen to honour you with one of their prized horses.
1879160016.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter when Kindred with the Galadhrim.

1879180624.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Spring Festival for Mithril Coins. Also available from the 'Pick a Mount' package.

1879182800.Skill_Desc: Your Mischievous Glee extends to your fellowship, restoring both Morale and Power.

1879213904.Skill_Desc: Your fellowship attempts to strike Draigoch with a final blow.

1879216336.Skill_Desc: Restores the power of your Fellows and increases your melee damage while slowing all enemies around you.

1879233360.Skill_Desc: A piercing attack which deals Light Damage over time.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879238096.Skill_Desc: Lightning wreaths your enemy while restoring your own power.\n\nDamage will not interrupt the drain.

1879242320.Skill_Desc: One with nature and the elements the Mearas are adepts at using the natural world against their enemies; as students of nature, beasts and hidden lore so too are Lore-masters who study these wild horses.

1879243984.Skill_Desc: A damaging cry that has the potential to truly disrupt your enemies and inspire you and your allies.

1879244240.Skill_Desc: A good Burglar knows how to plan for any situation and how to apply their knowledge to the best outcome at all times.

1879244880.Skill_Desc: The ultimate expression of tactical horsemanship, this is a dangerous strike on its own; when enhanced by the Red Dawn Discipline your melee damage is increased.

1879248336.Skill_Desc:
You unleash the culmination of your musical efforts into a power blast of light-based damage affecting an enemy target and those near the enemy.

<rgb=#00FFDD>Requires 3 ballad buffs present on the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#00FFDD>Active Anthems add enhanced effects to the Coda.</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Ballads from the Minstrel.</rgb>
<rgb=#FF7700>Removes all Anthems from Minstrel.</rgb>

1879255504.Skill_Desc: A simple passing attack that increases attacking strength when successful.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879271248.Skill_Desc:
Drawing upon your deep well of knowledge and lore, you are able to focus your abilities, improving many skills.
Each time you use an improved skill, you will expend one Mastery.

<rgb=#00CCFF>Fire and Frost Lore:</rgb> Becomes AoE
<rgb=#00CCFF>SoP:Righteousness:</rgb> +20s Duration
<rgb=#00CCFF>SoP:See All Ends:</rgb> Doubled Effectiveness
<rgb=#00CCFF>SoP: Vigilance:</rgb> Increases allies' Critical Defence
<rgb=#00CCFF>Air Lore:</rgb> Applies a Bubble
<rgb=#00CCFF>Water Lore:</rgb> Becomes AoE
<rgb=#00CCFF>Beacon of Hope:</rgb> Increased Potency
<rgb=#00CCFF>Wind Lore:</rgb> Increased Potency
<rgb=#00CCFF>Burning Embers:</rgb> Becomes AoE
<rgb=#00CCFF>Gust of Wind:</rgb> Increased Damage and applies Brittle Frost
<rgb=#00CCFF>Wizard's Frost:</rgb> Becomes AoE and Increases Enemy Inductions
<rgb=#00CCFF>Wizard's Fire:</rgb> Devastating Burn
<rgb=#00CCFF>Wizard's Spark:</rgb> Stuns Target

1879286480.Skill_Desc: A bunch of caltrops that stick in enemies feet and continue to damage them.

1879288144.Skill_Desc: A powerful sword swing that damages enemies in front.

1879302608.Skill_Desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879322064.Skill_Desc: Even in the darkest times, you give your allies hope.\n\nThis ability can be used in combat.

1879326032.Skill_Desc: A horse from the Farmers Faire.
1879326032.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Farmer's Faire Festival for Mithril Coins.

1879335504.Skill_Desc: Summons a tamed Variag hound to keep you company.
1879335504.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available as a possible drop in the Throne of the Dread Terror Raid: Tier 2 Challenge.

1879335632.Skill_Desc: A pony from the White City who took part in the Battle of the Pelennor Fields.
1879335632.Skill_Name: Battle-worn Steed of the White City
1879335632.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Limited availability in the LOTRO Store.

1879369424.Skill_Desc: Brings out a songbird to keep you company.
1879369424.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter from Featured Challenges.

1879411792.Skill_Desc: A sudden feint leaves your enemy off-balance and grants you the Mettle to quickly finish them.

1879447376.Skill_Desc: Brings out a friendly corgi to keep you company.
1879447376.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter from Theodore Gorse during the Treasure Bugan Event.

1879449424.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Only available from the Luxurious Rivendell supporter pack.

1879478480.Skill_Desc: You briefly regain yourself, increasing your Morale.

1879486032.Skill_Desc: Summons a big cat companion.\n\nThe cat is capable of attacking multiple foes at once.

1879492176.Skill_Desc: Acrid salts from the wastes of Malenhad force your target to awaken with a renewed blood lust.

1879496912.Skill_Desc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Galadriel. Will you be fair and terrible such that all will love you?
1879496912.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: A finely-crafted costume in the guise of Galadriel. Will you be fair and terrible such that all will love you?

1879506256.Skill_Desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Dun Shûma in Khûd Zagin in the Ikorbân Valley.

1879507792.Skill_Desc: Devoting yourself to acid, you draw upon the poison, diseases, and virulence within the world. With this power, you transform all your damaging skills into acidic attacks.

1879516880.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Kingdoms of Harad Ultimate Fan Bundle.

1879528272.Skill_Desc: Using fell knowledge and potions, breathe a gout of living shadow upon your foes.

1879528784.Skill_Desc: Send a spike of acid at your target, weakening them.

1879529168.Skill_Desc: This is a ground-targeted skill with limited targets.
